item.product: INCA (Infant Nasal Cannulae Assy) Neonatal Nasal CPAP, Replacement Set. Stay-Flex tubing component. 5 units per box. Model Numbers: 44-0712,
item.summary: Potential to exhibit a loose connection between the flexible tubing and the nasal cannula, during assembly or while in use, which may result in loss of CPAP pressure, possibly reducing the effectiveness of treatment and lead to decreased oxygenation until connection is restored. Product details: INCA (Infant Nasal Cannulae Assy) Neonatal Nasal CPAP, Replacement Set. Stay-Flex tubing component. 5 units per box. Model Numbers: 44-0712, 44-0707, 44-0709, 44-0715.
item.affectedPeople: Nationwide distribution to CT, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, MD, MI, MS, NJ, NY, OH, PA, VA. International distribution to Brazil and Peru.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
